gloss: Continuous observation of state over time
mechanism: A persistent process that uses a {{loop}} to repeatedly execute {{observe}} on a target {{system}} or {{state}} at defined intervals. It compares the observed state against a baseline or invariant, emitting a {{signal}} if a deviation ({{anomaly}}) is detected.
invariants: Perturbs what it observes: repeated {{observe}} consumes resources at the target and leaves records there. The degree varies; the fact does not.
failure_modes: Monitoring load becomes the {{anomaly}}: the observation cost is large enough to shift the baseline it is measuring against.
Baseline drift: the target changes legitimately and the unchanged baseline reports it as deviation.
